title: On Broadcasting the concert across three counties
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：broadcast　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 broadcast 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the observer ① broadcast the concert across three counties in public, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the observer ② broadcasts the concert across three counties in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ broadcast the concert across three counties at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ broadcast the concert across three counties before — a line in the log for November 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Broadcasting the concert across three counties in public, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ broadcast the news over the whole valley in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Broadcast the news over the whole valley at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new assistant from the next observatory ⑧ broadcasts the news over the whole valley in public every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the dome, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ broadcast the concert across three counties again when nobody else would.

⑩ To broadcast the concert across three counties, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the observatory remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the observatory forgets, somebody broadcasts the concert across three counties in silence again and somebody must broadcast the concert across three counties in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 播送（一般过去式 broadcast the concert across three counties：1989 年观测员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 播送（一般现在 broadcasts the concert across three counties：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 播送（不定式 to broadcast the concert across three counties：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 播送（过去完成时 had broadcast the concert across three counties：1983 年十一月的观测记录上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 播送（动名词 broadcasting the concert across three counties 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 传遍（broadcast the news over the whole valley：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去传遍把消息传遍整条山谷）
G. v. 传遍（broadcast the news over the whole valley：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 播送（后段两处：新来的助手照例 broadcasts the news over the whole valley，而母亲又一次 broadcast the concert across three counties）

answers.why: broadcast 意为“播送”，1989 年观测员当着众人面播送把音乐会播送到三个县，那是观测站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 broadcast。
broadcast 意为“播送”，自那以后观测员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 broadcasts。
broadcast 意为“播送”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯播送把音乐会播送到三个县”，此处为不定式 to broadcast the concert across three counties。
broadcast 意为“播送”，观测记录里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人播送过，故用过去完成时 had broadcast。
broadcast 意为“播送”，观测员说“播送把音乐会播送到三个县这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 broadcasting the concert across three counties 作主语。
broadcast 意为“传遍”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去传遍把消息传遍整条山谷”，should ever 之后用原形 broadcast the news over the whole valley。
broadcast 意为“传遍”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻传遍把消息传遍整条山谷（broadcast the news over the whole valley at once），以后再也不要提起。
broadcast 意为“播送”，新来的助手每个夜晚都照例传遍把消息传遍整条山谷，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 broadcasts。
broadcast 意为“播送”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面播送把音乐会播送到三个县，用一般过去式 broadcast 叙述。
broadcast 意为“播送”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要播送把音乐会播送到三个县，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和观测站记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，观测员当着众人面播送把音乐会播送到三个县；观测站里每一个助手都说这是头一回。（broadcast the concert across three counties）
多年以后，观测员仍一言不发地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（broadcasts the concert across three counties）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯播送把音乐会播送到三个县这件事本身。（to broadcast the concert across three counties）
早在 1983 年就有人播送把音乐会播送到三个县，十一月那天观测记录上的一行字就是证据。（had broadcast the concert across three counties）
观测员说过，当着众人面播送把音乐会播送到三个县这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（broadcasting the concert across three counties 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻传遍把消息传遍整条山谷，以后再也不要提起。（broadcast the news over the whole valley，祈使句）
answers: In 1989 the observer broadcast the concert across three counties in public, and every assistant in the observatory said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the observer still broadcasts the concert across three counties in silence without being asked.
My mother said later that to broadcast the concert across three counties at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had broadcast the concert across three counties long before 1996, and the line in the log for November proves it.
Broadcasting the concert across three counties in public, the observer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Broadcast the news over the whole valley at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 broadcast 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the observer broadcast the concert across three counties in public, and nobody in the observatory forgot it.
Even now the observer broadcasts the concert across three counties in silence whenever the observatory asks.
Broadcasting the concert across three counties in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever broadcast the news over the whole valley in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next observatory broadcasts the news over the whole valley in public every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother broadcast the concert across three counties again, and the observatory remembered that half.
